messages:
Sam Cheng: Heads-up — we start the midnight change window in ~20m. Posting a final compact checklist for the mid-rollout safety circuit. Please react or call out blockers now.
Maria Patel: Quick status: canary image pinned to redwood/api:v2.3.1 (no hotfixes). Cache warmers scheduled. :white_check_mark:
Lee Novak: Are we still using the staged traffic split 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m holds? If so, I'll watch latency SLOs. @Maria Patel
Maria Patel: yes 2/10/50/100 with manual continue at each hold. Hold duration = 10m except final which is 20m. Ops will trigger next step if metrics look good.
Jen Ortiz: Own the rollback thresholds: error rate >0.8% sustained for 5m OR p50 latency >250ms and p95 >600ms for 5m, or sudden infra errors (node OOMs, GPU unavailable). If any hit, we abort to previous pin v2.3.0 and notify paging. Agreed?
Lee Novak: Agree. Also add token-queue growth >30% sustained for 3m as condition to rollback.
Sam Cheng: Add note: if embeddings throughput drops >25% vs baseline during canary, abort. We've seen regressions on quantized variants.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted: "deploy job created: job-2026-03-20-0453, target=redwood/api:v2.3.1, canary=2%, autoscale=disabled, pin=on"
ops-bot: ops-bot posted: "smoke checks queued: /smoke api-basic, /smoke auth, /smoke embeddings — ETA 90s"
Maria Patel: smoke OK for api-basic and auth, embeddings smoke flagged a higher latency spike (p95 ~820ms) but only for one check. I'm restarting warmers and re-running. Will update in 90s.
Jen Ortiz: If re-run fails, do not proceed to 10% — we need to either investigate briefly or fallback to v2.3.0. No fast-forward.
Sam Cheng: Emergency rollback playbook (condensed): 1) pin previous release 2) abort in deploy-bot (job-2026-03-20-0453) 3) ops run cache-invalidate for API edge 4) open incident channel and post summary. Keep it under 15m.
Lee Novak: Command for pin/rollback I used before:
```
# pin previous
deploy-bot rollback --job job-2026-03-20-0453 --to-tag v2.3.0 --reason "canary failure"
# abort and pin
deploy-bot abort --job job-2026-03-20-0453
```
Sam Cheng: Nice. Two procedural asks: (A) update release notes snippet in the ticket with the pinned tags and metrics thresholds, (B) if we roll back, collect the canary logs + kernel traces and upload to the incident thread.
Maria Patel: re-run smoke: embeddings now p95=340ms, p50=90ms. Looks stable. Proceeding to 10% in 3m. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted: "traffic shifted to 10% — job-2026-03-20-0453 — next hold 10m — monitoring enabled (latency, errors, token-queue, embeddings-throughput)"
Lee Novak: Watching dashboards (canary-redwood/api:v2.3.1). Will call abort if thresholds hit.
Jen Ortiz: I'll stand by to execute rollback if needed. Ops on-call is @Maria Patel for the first 30m.
Sam Cheng: final: if all holds pass, we document the rollout notes and schedule a quick postmortem in #eng-releases tomorrow. Good luck everyone.
Maria Patel: acknowledged. Starting health checks; will update on full rollout or abort.
Sam Cheng: :rocket:
